reasons: Analysts have cut FY consensus EPS [earnings per share] from 150.99 to 150.68 in 30 days, with zero upward revisions, so estimates are rolling over.

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-15 report, with the long leg expiring 2026-12-18, which gives the deterioration time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The credit ratio clears the floor, but the net debit is $6,635 per spread, so size it small. The short put expires before earnings, leaving the long put to capture any post-earnings slide; the main risk is a sharp rally that leaves the short put worthless but the long put losing time value.
